name: dpia_screening
description: Screen whether a processing operation needs a GDPR data protection impact assessment: the nine criteria of the WP29/EDPB guidelines (WP248 rev.01) given as booleans or hinted from a description in English or Spanish, the rule that two or more criteria usually mean a DPIA is required, the mandatory cases of Article 35(3), the Recital 91 exception, and a pointer to the supervisory authority's Article 35(4) list (e.g. the AEPD's for Spain). Not legal advice.

description.description: Free text; keyword hints count for criteria not set explicitly

recital_91.description: Patients' or clients' data processed by an individual physician, health professional or lawyer

catalog.source: Article 29 Working Party, Guidelines on Data Protection Impact Assessment (WP248 rev.01, 4 October 2017, endorsed by the EDPB), section III.B and its examples; Regulation (EU) 2016/679 Art. 35 and Recital 91
